title: TypeOpCall::getInputLocal callspec, slot, lock, size, this-pointer, and FSPEC dispatch
status_note: D1 (production commit 8b8b541) implements TypeOpCall::get_input_local per typeop.cc:687-718. The locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle and the frozen D1 Rugra snapshot were each executed twice with deterministic stdout/stderr. Ghidra produced 167 records / 6369 bytes; Rugra produced 167 records / 6367 bytes. The byte comparison is MISMATCH with 12 diff records / 348 bytes (SHA-256 bd841375a824e5e517c90a871b209b889a5038c862ade863c7b05d643d555487): exactly two lines differ, representation.fspec_name (fspec vs iop) and representation.fspec_type (4 vs 5), the registered CALLSPEC-0001/TYPEOP-FSPEC-SPACE-0001 input-representation residual. All 13 behavior cases and their identity bits are byte-identical. Overall remains MISMATCH and this evidence cannot support L3.

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: Ghidra decodes the exact FuncCallSpecs pointer from input0 and returns canonical TypeFactory-owned Datatype pointers. Two FSPEC Varnodes alias the same callspec and repeated calls preserve pointer identity. Rugra's Funcdata owns one stable Arc, both annotations carry typed Weak handles to that exact allocation, and TypeOpCall::get_input_local now upgrades input0's Weak through the Iop+ANNOTATION gate and returns the same canonical factory Arc identities; entry-address/pointer diagnostic bits are compatibility shadows only.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: There is no container scan inside getInputLocal. The ordered guards are slot==0 or non-FSPEC, param=slot-1, parameter present, locked branch before this-pointer branch, non-void and size<=input-size, then pointer-to-struct. Fixture cases run in a fixed order and include slot 0, the final existing parameter, and the first missing parameter.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: The only index adjustment is slot-1 exactly once after the FSPEC guard. Lock state is cleared once and restored once on the same parameter object before alias and non-FSPEC probes; no per-case callspec copies are made.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: No sorting occurs. Decisive comparisons are address-space type equality with IPTR_FSPEC, parameter type-lock and this-pointer flags, metatype equality/inequality, datatype size <= input Varnode size, canonical datatype pointer identity, exact Arc owner identity, and exact PcodeOp identity. Numeric-bit equality alone cannot resolve the distinct Const-space fake.

residuals.note: D1 dispatch-level port is behaviorally verified against the locked oracle (all 13 cases byte-identical). Remaining: the two representation lines differ because Rugra still has no dedicated FSPEC address space, and the production ActionInferTypes caller closure (D2) is not wired, so end-to-end output impact is UNTESTED.

D0 replaces vector-index decoding with a stable Arc owner, typed Weak annotation, and exact op lookup. A direct entry address remains as a legacy PrintC compatibility shadow (or a pointer diagnostic when missing), but numeric bits never establish identity. Varnode still uses AddressSpace::Iop rather than the Architecture-owned FSPEC space+pointer codec observed by Ghidra.
Even after TypeOpCall input typing is implemented, the ActionInferTypes and PrintC consuming closure must be bilaterally verified before hugehelp string rendering can be claimed fixed.
